title: Exquisite Melted Canadian Cheese Lasagna
description: A rich and indulgent take on the classic lasagna, featuring a Canadian twist with cultured cheese and yuzu-cure.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine the cultured Canadian cheddar cheese, ayurvedic tamasic-friendly ricotta cheese, yuzu juice, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna noodles, celery, and fresh parsley. Toss to combine.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top.
Spread half of the remaining cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the remaining celery and parsley mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the cheese mixture, and finally the remaining celery and parsley mixture.
Drizzle the extra-virgin olive oil over the top layer of cheese and sprinkle with salt.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
